summary: Three KPI cards where the trend colour follows what is good news: churn falling is green, response time rising is red, sessions are neutral.
use: Metrics where down is good (churn, cost, latency) or where a change is not a judgement, with an accurate better/worse screen reader label.
spec: `<KpiCard title="Churn Rate" value="5.2" unit="%" trend={-1.8} trendTone="positive-down" icon={UserMinus} />`: a fall is green, announced "better"
`<KpiCard title="Response Time" value="1.4" unit="s" trend={12.3} trendTone="positive-down" icon={Gauge} />`: a rise is red, announced "worse"
`<KpiCard title="Sessions" value="3,847" trend={-2.1} trendTone="neutral" icon={Activity} />`: arrow only, no colour judgement
